item.title: Noah Kahan’s ‘The Great Divide’ Spends Second Week Atop Billboard 200
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update. We're breaking down the latest from the Billboard 200 chart. Let's dive in."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Noah Kahan's album 'The Great Divide' is holding strong at number one for the second week in a row. It earned 163,000 equivalent album units in the US, with 137,000 of those coming from streaming. This makes it the first rock album to spend at least two weeks at number one in nearly three years."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But 'The Great Divide' isn't the only newsmaker on the chart. Kacey Musgraves is debuting at number three with her new album 'Middle of Nowhere', earning 100,000 equivalent album units. This is her sixth top 10 album, and all of them have debuted in the top five. 'Middle of Nowhere' features collaborations with big names like Gregory Alan Isakov, Miranda Lambert, and Willie Nelson."
[Short music transition]
Host: "And in other chart news, the Michael Jackson biopic 'Michael' is still making waves. Two of his albums are in the top 10, with 'Thriller' rising to number five and 'Number Ones' jumping to number six. Ella Langley's 'Dandelion' is holding steady at number two, and Kacey Musgraves' 'Middle of Nowhere' is making a strong debut at number three."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for this week's music update. For more chart news, follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on social media. And tune in next time for more music news and updates."
